scope: Deterministic non-live duplicate observation, canonical lifecycle, and notification proof

fixture.duplicateInput: same complete snapshot and canonical observation submitted twice

proof.persistenceTest: packages/db/src/repos/operations.test.ts :: deduplicates repeated observations to one signal, case, and alert
proof.lifecycleTest: packages/db/src/repos/operations.test.ts :: resolves from fresh evidence and reopens the same operational objects
proof.deliveryTest: apps/collector/src/jobs/operational-condition-finalizer.test.ts :: sends only newly-created or reopened canonical alerts
assertions: two repeated observations create one internal signal, one internal case, one alert, and one opening event
resolution and a newer regression reuse those same operational object IDs
delivery occurs for initial create and reopen only, never for the duplicate observation
